subject: Estimate for proportional odds model and logistic regression model

messages.author: 2d2a4f5aa0df3ec7
messages.subject: Estimate for proportional odds model and logistic regression model
parts:
Hi,

I am fitting a proportional odds model using INLA. I noticed in the pom documentation, it stated that the intercepts are parametrized in a different way which makes sense. However, the linear predictor is fitted in the model by being subtracted from the intercept term.  I am wondering if this is the same case for logistic regression models. Is the linear predictor also subtracted from the intercept term?


Best,
Jocelyn

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Estimate for proportional odds model and logistic regression model
parts:
In standard logistic regression everything is as normal
